function.arguments:
{"command":"set -u
LANE=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin
EVID="$LANE/.ufo/waves/round-59/build/MutFamily"
SCRIPT="$LANE/scripts/cite-sources.mjs"
REV=5469c0a58d7986ff8a5f203938ae1c8785a92213
mkdir -p "$EVID"
{
  date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ
  date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z
  node -v
  command -v node
  git -C "$LANE" rev-parse HEAD
  git -C "$LANE" rev-parse --verify "${REV}^{commit}"
  git -C "$LANE" log -1 --format='%H%n%s' "$REV"
  git -C "$LANE" merge-base --is-ancestor "$REV" HEAD
  echo "ancestor_exit=$?"
  git -C "$LANE" status --porcelain -- scripts/cite-sources.mjs
  echo "status_exit=$?"
  git -C "$LANE" diff --exit-code "$REV" -- scripts/cite-sources.mjs
  echo "diff_exit=$?"
  git -C "$LANE" hash-object scripts/cite-sources.mjs
  git -C "$LANE" rev-parse "${REV}:scripts/cite-sources.mjs"
} > "$EVID/00-identity.txt" 2> "$EVID/00-identity.stderr"
sha256sum "$SCRIPT" > "$EVID/wt.sha256"
git -C "$LANE" show "${REV}:scripts/cite-sources.mjs" | sha256sum > "$EVID/blob.sha256"
git -C "$LANE" show "${REV}:scripts/cite-sources.mjs" | awk 'NR>=1 && NR<=20 || NR==26 || NR>=42 && NR<=50 { printf "%d\t%s\n", NR, $0 }' > "$EVID/rule-excerpt.txt"
node -v > "$EVID/node.version"
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/mutfamily.XXXXXXXX)
case "$TMP" in
  /tmp/*) ;;
  *) echo "refusing non-/tmp fixture dir: $TMP" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
printf '%s\n' "$TMP" > "$EVID/tmp.path"
printf '%s\n' '| `knowledge/ops-watchers.md` | family S6 and S7 |' > "$TMP/README.md"
printf '%s\n' '| id | source |' '|---|---|' '| S112 | example |' '| S122 | example |' > "$TMP/SOURCES.md"
cp -a "$TMP/README.md" "$EVID/readme.fixture"
cp -a "$TMP/SOURCES.md" "$EVID/sources.fixture"
sha256sum "$TMP/README.md" "$TMP/SOURCES.md" > "$EVID/fixture.sha256"
cat -A "$TMP/README.md" > "$EVID/readme.cat-A"
